message.content: Comments in this codebase use lowercase with square-bracket annotations to enforce a consistent, machine-readable format that pairs human-readable notes with structured metadata. The lowercase style ensures uniformity and avoids confusion with variable names, while the square brackets (e.g., `// [TODO: fix edge case]` or `// [BUG: null pointer on input X])` clearly delineate the type of annotation—such as `TODO`, `FIXME`, or `BUG—making it easy to parse programmatically or filter issues. This convention also aligns with the project's style guide, which prioritizes clarity and maintainability by treating comments as part of the code's documentation infrastructure rather than ad-hoc remarks.
